title_native: ドラゴンボール超 ビルス
episode_title: When a God Loses His Patience
pullquote: You can feel the entire screen shiver when a God of Destruction stops playing around. This episode turns party comedy into pure, suffocating dread in a single frame.
quick_take: You can feel the entire screen shiver when a God of Destruction stops playing around. This episode turns party comedy into pure, suffocating dread in a single frame.
one_sentence_verdict: A masterclass in sudden tension breaking into explosive action that reminds fans exactly why Beerus sits at the top of the food chain.
synopsis_paragraphs: That sudden drop in tone hit like a sack of bricks. One second we are watching desperate party antics, and the next, the ambient noise cuts out completely. You see that tight zoom on Beerus's eye right before his aura flares? That is how you turn a lighthearted gathering into absolute survival horror.

When a God of Destruction decides he is done playing nice, the entire atmosphere tightens until your throat goes dry. The sheer speed of the escalation in this episode proves why these enhanced visuals were necessary. The frame rate snaps into overdrive the second the punches start throwing, making every single blow feel like it could split the ocean in half.
sakuga_paragraphs:
- **Craft point:** Chief Animation Director Tadayoshi Yamamuro keeps the character line art exceptionally crisp right up to the moment of impact, letting the sudden burst of high-speed sakuga hit with maximum violence.
- **Craft point:** Director of Photography Yousuke Motoki pulls back the bright party hues and drenches the frame in harsh, high-contrast light during the aura flares, selling the terrifying divine pressure in the room.
- **Craft point:** Music composer Norihito Sumitomo strips away the grand orchestral background audio during key standoffs, using stark silence to magnify every heavy sound effect.
story_paragraphs:
- **「作画のキレがヤバい」 (*Sakuga no kire ga yabai* - "The animation crispness is insane"):** Same-night X threads immediately seized on the updated visual cuts, praising how snappier keyframes made the physical clashes feel terrifyingly fast.
- **「神の作法」 (*Kami no sahou* - "Manners of a God"):** Roundup threads on 5ch exploded over the terrifying mood shift when Beerus drops his polite party guest facade and displays true universal threat.
voice_paragraphs: - **Voice Acting highlight:** Kouichi Yamadera flips Beerus on a dime from lazy, cat-like boredom to spine-chilling malice, while Ryo Horikawa delivers raw, desperate terror as Vegeta scrambles to keep the peace.
takeaway_paragraphs: A masterclass in sudden tension breaking into explosive action that reminds fans exactly why Beerus sits at the top of the food chain. Catch this spectacular clash streaming right now on Netflix and Crunchyroll.
